arguments.command: date +"%Z %z"; python3 -c "import icalendar; print('icalendar', icalendar.__version__)" 2>&1 || echo "icalendar not installed"

python3 - <<'EOF'
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff"

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Project Kickoff//Calendar Skill//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
TZID:Asia/Shanghai
BEGIN:STANDARD
DTSTART:19700101T000000
TZOFFSETFROM:+0800
TZOFFSETTO:+0800
TZNAME:CST
END:STANDARD
END:VTIMEZONE
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{now}
DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260817T100000
DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260817T120000
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the project. Agenda: goals, scope, timeline, roles and responsibilities, next steps.
LOCATION:TBD
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
TRANSP:OPAQUE
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open('project_kickoff.ics', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(ics)

print("Created project_kickoff.ics")
print("Event: Project Kickoff Meeting")
print("Start: Monday, 2026-08-17 10:00 (Asia/Shanghai, UTC+8)")
print("End:   Monday, 2026-08-17 12:00 (Asia/Shanghai, UTC+8)")
EOF
